# Boss Height

Boss height compared with its outer diameter.

<figure markdown="span">
![Boss Height: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-boss-height-ratio-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Boss Height: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-boss-height-ratio-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Boss height against its outer diameter; tall, slender bosses fill and vent badly.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 2.5× outer diameter | 3.0× outer diameter | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Tall Boss (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, taller than the recommended `{target}` its outer diameter. Tall bosses are hard to fill and vent, and their core pins bend. Add gussets, or shorten the boss and raise the mating part to meet it.
!!! failure "Error"

    Boss Too Tall (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its outer diameter. Expect short shots, trapped gas at its tip and a core pin that deflects. Shorten the boss and raise the mating part to meet it, or brace it with gussets.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
